user.title: Connect to your Unite charger
user.description: Enter the charger's IP address. Modbus TCP must be enabled on the charger.

reconfigure.title: Change connection
reconfigure.description: Update the charger's IP address, port or Modbus unit ID.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the charger. Check the IP address, port and that Modbus TCP is enabled.

connection.title: Connection
connection.description: Where is your charger on your home network? You normally never need this again after setup.

data_description.host: E.g. 192.168.1.50. Find it in your router or the charger's web UI.
data_description.port: Default 502 — only change if you changed it on the charger itself.
data_description.unit_id: Default 255 — only change if the charger does not respond.

charge.title: Charging
charge.description: How the charger charges. Most people only need 'Who controls charging' and 'Charger connection' here.

data.phase_restore_on_unplug: Restore for Unite bug (stuck on 1 phase)

data_description.control_mode: Built-in = this integration decides how to charge. External = evcc (or another controller) decides; this integration only passes it on.
data_description.default_mode: Every session starts with this when you plug in. You can switch mode anytime while charging.
data_description.min_current: Normally 6 A. Adjustable 6–32 A (about 1.4 kW per phase at 6 A).
data_description.max_current: Normally 16 A (about 11 kW on 3 phases). Cannot be lower than the minimum.
data_description.grid_phases: Single- or three-phase, as your electrician wired it. If unsure, check the charger's web UI. This setting also keeps the phase fixes below from running on the wrong installation.
data_description.phase_switching: Lets the charger switch between 1-phase (efficient with little sun) and 3-phase (fast). Only enable on a three-phase connection.
data_description.phase_recovery_enabled: Some cars don't pick up 3 phases by themselves after switching — then the charger pauses briefly so the car restarts on 3 phases. Interrupts charging briefly, so off by default.
data_description.phase_restore_on_unplug: Works around a charger bug where a new session starts on 1 phase even though 3 phases are configured. After every unplug the charger is briefly set to 1 phase and back to 3 phases, forcing it to apply its own default. Requires the web UI login and a three-phase connection.

meter.title: Power meter
meter.description: This tells the charger how much solar surplus you have. Used for solar charging and the fuse guard.

meter_signed.title: Signed grid power sensor
meter_signed.description: Your meter reports one number: positive when using power, negative (or the other way) when exporting. Pick that sensor here.

data_description.grid_export_negative: On if your meter goes negative when the sun shines (like HomeWizard). Off if export is positive.
data_description.nominal_voltage: Usually 230 V. Only used to convert watts to amps.

meter_dsmr.title: Import + export sensors
meter_dsmr.description: Your meter reports usage and export as two separate numbers. Pick both sensors here.

data_description.nominal_voltage: Usually 230 V. Only used to convert watts to amps.

meter_surplus.title: Surplus sensor
meter_surplus.description: You already have a sensor that reports the solar surplus directly (positive = surplus). Pick it here.

data_description.nominal_voltage: Usually 230 V. Only used to convert watts to amps.

dlb.title: Fuse guard (DLB)
dlb.description: Watches your main fuse: charging is throttled when your home uses a lot of power, so the fuse never trips.

data_description.dlb_enabled: Off = the charger ignores your home usage.
data_description.main_fuse_a: Usually 25 A. Check your meter cupboard if unsure.
data_description.dlb_margin_a: Keeps a little headroom below the fuse. Normally 2 A.
data_description.dlb_current_l1: Required. Phase 2 and 3 only needed on a three-phase connection.

solar.title: Solar
solar.description: Fine-tuning for the Solar and Minimum + Solar modes. Only needed if the defaults don't suit you.

data_description.solar_min_current: Charging starts when the surplus covers this. Normally 6 A.
data_description.phase_switch_dwell: Waits this long before switching between 1 and 3 phases, so passing clouds don't cause constant switching. Normally 300 s.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Only change these if you know why. Wrong values can stall charging. The timers below only apply when their switch (on the Charging screen) is on.

data.failsafe_current: Backup current if contact is lost

data_description.poll_interval: How often the charger is polled. Normally 10 s.
data_description.failsafe_current: The charger falls back to this if it hears nothing for a while. Normally 6 A; 0 A stops charging entirely.
data_description.failsafe_timeout: How long the silence may last before the backup kicks in. Normally 30 s.
data_description.phase_recovery_observe: How long to watch before concluding the car is stuck on 1 phase. Normally 60 s.
data_description.phase_recovery_dwell: How long charging pauses so the car restarts on 3 phases. Normally 121 s.
data_description.phase_restore_delay: Lets the charger finish the session. Plugging back in within this time cancels the restore. Normally 5 s.

reboot.title: Web UI
reboot.description: Logs in to the charger's web interface. This adds a Restart button — only use it when the charger is stuck, it stops an ongoing charging session. The login is also required for "Restore for Unite bug" on the Charging screen.

data_description.rest_username: Usually "admin". Needed once to log in to the charger.
data_description.rest_password: The password of the charger's web UI (on the sticker or set by you). Stored locally only.

error.min_above_max: Minimum current cannot be higher than the maximum.
error.not_power: That looks like an energy sensor (kWh). Please pick a power sensor (W/kW).
error.dlb_needs_l1: Enabling DLB requires at least the L1 grid current sensor.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the charger. Check the IP address, port and that Modbus TCP is enabled.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid web UI username or password.
error.rest_cannot_connect: Cannot reach the charger's web UI. Check that it is on and reachable.

options.none: None — no solar, no fuse guard
